summary.en: French AI lab offering frontier open-weight and proprietary models with strong reasoning, coding, and multimodal capabilities via a unified API.
summary.zh: 法国 AI 实验室，提供开源权重与专有模型，涵盖推理、代码与多模态能力，通过统一 API 调用。

title.en: Mistral AI API Key - Official La Plateforme Access | Get Model Key
title.zh: Mistral AI API Key - 官方 La Plateforme 入口 | Get Model Key

description.en: Get your Mistral AI API key from La Plateforme. Access Codestral, Magistral, Devstral and more with a free tier or pay-as-you-go plan.
description.zh: 从 Mistral La Plateforme 获取 API Key，可访问 Codestral、Magistral、Devstral 等模型，提供免费层及按需付费计划。

en: Mistral AI is a French AI company founded in 2023 by former DeepMind and Meta researchers. It offers both open-weight models and proprietary frontier models through its La Plateforme API, covering text, code, and multimodal tasks.

Developers choose Mistral for its strong coding (Codestral, Devstral), reasoning (Magistral), and embedding model lineup, plus OpenAI-compatible endpoints and a free tier that requires no credit card to start.
zh: Mistral AI 是 2023 年由前 DeepMind 和 Meta 研究员创立的法国 AI 公司，通过 La Plateforme API 提供开源权重模型及专有前沿模型，覆盖文本、代码与多模态任务。
开发者常因其代码（Codestral、Devstral）、推理（Magistral）与嵌入模型而选择 Mistral，平台提供兼容 OpenAI 的接口及无需绑卡的免费层。

en: Go to console.mistral.ai and sign up or sign in with your account.
In the left sidebar, navigate to 'API Keys', then click 'Create new key'.
Name your key, copy it immediately — it is shown only once.
To use the API beyond the free tier limits, go to 'Subscription' and enable Pay-as-you-go.
Use the key as a Bearer token against Mistral's OpenAI-compatible base URL: api.mistral.ai/v1.
zh: 前往 console.mistral.ai 注册或登录账号。
在左侧菜单点击「API Keys」，再点击「Create new key」。
为 Key 命名后立即复制保存，密钥仅展示一次。
如需超出免费层限制，前往「Subscription」页面开启 Pay-as-you-go。
以 Bearer Token 方式调用 api.mistral.ai/v1（兼容 OpenAI 接口）。

question.en: Is there a free tier for the Mistral API?

answer.en: Yes. All accounts include limited API access for free. Pay-as-you-go must be explicitly enabled in the Subscription page to access higher rate limits.
answer.zh: 有。所有账号默认包含有限的免费 API 访问额度。如需更高速率限制，需在 Subscription 页面手动开启 Pay-as-you-go。

question.zh: Mistral API 兼容 OpenAI 格式吗？

answer.en: Yes. La Plateforme exposes OpenAI-compatible endpoints at api.mistral.ai/v1. You can often swap the base URL and API key in existing OpenAI SDK code.
answer.zh: 是。La Plateforme 在 api.mistral.ai/v1 提供兼容 OpenAI 的接口，通常只需替换 base URL 和 API Key 即可复用现有 OpenAI SDK 代码。

question.en: Can I access Mistral from China?
question.zh: 国内可以访问 Mistral API 吗？

answer.en: Mistral does not have a China-specific site or domestic mirror. Access from mainland China may require a proxy. Consider aggregator platforms like Silicon Flow that offer Mistral-equivalent models with domestic access.
answer.zh: Mistral 没有国内站或国内镜像，中国大陆直接访问可能需要代理。可考虑硅基流动等聚合平台，部分提供类似模型且国内可直连。

title.en: Free tier — limited API access included
title.zh: 免费层：默认包含有限 API 访问

benefit.en: All accounts get limited API access for free with no credit card required. Rate limits vary by model — see the limits page at console.mistral.ai for details.
benefit.zh: 所有账号默认免费获得有限 API 访问权限，无需绑卡。各模型速率限制不同，详见 console.mistral.ai 的 limits 页面。

notes.en: Enable Pay-as-you-go in the Subscription page to unlock higher rate limits beyond the free tier.
notes.zh: 在 Subscription 页面开启 Pay-as-you-go 可解锁更高速率限制。
